title: Include pod-spec-level Secret references in field-path discovery
context: Production Helm chart validation revealed that imagePullSecrets[].name (a pod-spec-level Secret reference) is a common, legitimate pattern that the original field-path table never enumerated. Six rounds of adversarial code review focused on parsing correctness missed this as a gap in field-path *completeness*, not a parsing defect.
decision: Add imagePullSecrets[].name to the Secret reference suffixes, expanding field-path discovery beyond container-scoped references to include pod-spec-level ones. This captures a real-world authoring pattern without breaking charts that use indirection.
consequences: Extracts imagePullSecrets references that were previously missed in direct or templated field assignments
Increases field-path suffixes to maintain (now tracks both container- and pod-spec-scoped Secret refs)
Is inert against charts using Helm helpers/indirection — adds no new false positives
alternatives_rejected: Stay with container-scoped references only — leaves common real-world pattern uncovered
Discover imagePullSecrets dynamically instead of enumerating it — still requires knowing the field exists
